author: bfonta
body:
#### PR description:

Introduce the infrastructure for PF DQM at HLT, based on what is available for offline DQM.

+ Significant rewrite of the `PFAnalyzer` DQMEDAnalyzer to support both online and offline data types
  + removal of the `PFCandidateAnalyzerDQM` DQMEDAnalyzer by integrating all its functionalities in `PFAnalyzer`
  + add a couple of histograms, inspired by https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51870/
  + add functionality to guarantee `MonitorElement`s exist before being filled, avoid potential segmentation violations
+ Include pileup offset plots via the existing DQMEDAnalyzer
  + fix a bug/inconsistency in the definition of what a "good" vertex is, by considering the `fabs(pv.position().rho()) <= 2.0` cut everywhere
  + HLT/AOD support for the first time (previously commented out)
+ Include CPU vs GPU comparisons
  + removal of duplicated producer for the offline chain
  + speed-up $O(n^2)$ cluster looping with a linear search map
+ Migrate most of the files from `Validation/` to `DQMOffline/`

Despite the migration, the PF and offset analyzers are left in the validation step, added in `HLTriggerOffline/Common/python/HLTValidation_cff.py`:

```python
_hltvalidationWithMC_Phase2.insert(-1, hltPFDQM)
```

It is my understanding that we should wait for https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/48976 before adding everything to the DQM step.

#### PR validation:

Tested locally with:

```bash
#!/bin/bash

NEVENTS=16
NTHREADS=16
GEOMETRY="ExtendedRun4D121"
CONDITIONS="auto:phase2_realistic_T35"
ERA="Phase2C26I13M9"

INFILES=file:/eos/cms/store/relval/CMSSW_20_0_0/RelValQCD_FlatPt_15_3000HS_14/GEN-SIM-DIGI-RAW/PU_150X_mcRun4_realistic_v1_STD_D121_RegeneratedGS_PU_16Aug26-v6/2590000/f6a17c63-819f-4721-97c2-5190b9986981.root

cmsDriver.py step2 -s L1P2GT,HLT:@relvalRun4,VALIDATION:@hltValidation \
			 --conditions ${CONDITIONS} \
			 --geometry ${GEOMETRY} \
			 --era ${ERA} \
			 --eventcontent DQMIO \
			 --datatier DQMIO \
			 --filein ${INFILES[@]} \
			 --fileout file:step2_inDQM.root \
			 -n ${NEVENTS} \
			 --nThreads ${NTHREADS} \
			 --python_filename step2_D121.py \
			 --processName reHLT \
			 --mc \
			 --no_exec

cmsDriver.py step3 -s HARVESTING:@hltValidation \
	     -n ${NEVENTS} \
	     --conditions ${CONDITIONS} \
	     --mc \
	     --geometry ${GEOMETRY} \
	     --era ${ERA} \
	     --filetype DQM \
	     --scenario pp \
	     --hltProcess HLTX \
		 --no_exec \
	     --filein file:step2_inDQM.root \
	     --fileout file:step3.root
```

For the CPU vs GPU comparison, given it is produced in the DQM step, I used `DQM:@hltGPUvsCPU` instead of `VALIDATION:@hltValidation`, and `HARVESTING:@hltGPUvsCPU` instead of `HARVESTING:@hltValidation`.
Additionally, for the CPU vs GPU comparison to work, I add to replace the serial collection (which does not seem to exist any longer) by the GPU:

```python
hltPfHcalGPUComparisonTask = pfHcalGPUComparisonTask.clone(
    subsystem = cms.untracked.string("HLT"),
    name = cms.untracked.string('HeterogeneousComparisons/ParticleFlow'),
    #pfClusterToken_ref = cms.untracked.InputTag('hltParticleFlowClusterHCALSerialSync'),
    pfClusterToken_ref = cms.untracked.InputTag('hltParticleFlowClusterHCAL'),
    pfClusterToken_target = cms.untracked.InputTag('hltParticleFlowClusterHCAL'),   
)
```

The plots are stored under `reHLT/` instead of `HLT/`, but otherwise the structure is kept.

#### Note

Currently the CPU vs GPU comparison only considers HCAL cluster collections. We should likely extend it to ECAL and HGCAL, but that is the matter for a separate future PR. 

_____

Co-authored by @waredjeb.
title: Particle Flow DQM at HLT.
